I still can't determine which desktop patch introduced the Tiki Totem. A fresh search returned no patch number for it, and the general patch-list pages it surfaced don't mention the item. The Tiki Totem wiki page and the Desktop version history page (both cited earlier) are the most likely places to settle it, but I haven't been able to retrieve a version entry from either.

Sources: [terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki](https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Tiki), [terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Desktop](https://terraria.wiki.gg/wiki/Desktop), [terraria.fandom.com/wiki/PC_version_history](https://terraria.fandom.com/wiki/PC_version_history)
